# Aetheris — Revenue Systems for Specialty Manufacturers

> Aetheris helps specialty manufacturers ($5M–$25M revenue, US-based) find the $200K–$2M they're losing to broken CRM, sales follow-up, and operational systems — and fix it. Indianapolis-based. 21-Day Revenue Diagnostic at $18,500 fixed fee. Implementation Retainer at $15K/month for Diagnostic clients.

## About
- Name: Aetheris (also: Aetheris AI, Aetheris Technology)
- Positioning: Revenue systems operator for specialty manufacturers
- Founder & Operator: Joseph Toney — 20 years building revenue systems for manufacturers, Marine Corps veteran, former Director of Strategy at a $25M aerospace firm with SpaceX accounts
- Location: Indianapolis, Indiana, United States
- Phone: (317) 376-2110
- Email: aetheris.technology@outlook.com
- Website: https://businessforensics.tech
- Service area: United States (HQ Indianapolis, IN — remote + on-site)
